hero.title: Acoustic and lighting design, as one.
hero.subtitle: onoff studio is the Indigoff design studio for spaces that need to sound as good as they look.
hero.imageAlt: Acoustic leaf canopy with integrated light over a lounge

what.title: We design how a space sounds and how it is lit — together.
what.p1: Most projects treat acoustics and lighting as two separate problems. At onoff studio we solve them as one: every fixture we design absorbs sound and shapes light at the same time, so ceilings and walls stay clean and the room feels calm.
what.p2: We work with architects, interior designers and end clients on offices, hospitality, education and retail — from a single statement piece to the full acoustic and lighting plan of a building.

services.title: Acoustic design
services.text: Reverberation and noise analysis of your space, with a clear recommendation of what to treat and where.

services.title: Lighting design
services.text: Lighting plans and fixture layouts that balance mood, function and energy use.

services.title: Custom acoustic fixtures
services.text: One-of-a-kind acoustic lights designed for your project, in any shape, size and color.

services.title: Coordination and installation
services.text: Shop drawings, samples, production and on-site support until the space is finished.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: We study the space, its use and its sound.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: We propose the acoustic and lighting concept, with renders and simulations.

steps.title: Make
steps.text: Indigoff produces each piece from recycled PET felt with integrated LED.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: We coordinate delivery and installation with your team.

designs.title: onoff studio designs

cta.title: Let’s design your space.
cta.text: Tell us about your project and the onoff studio team will propose an acoustic and lighting concept.
